description: Logical catalog of every dataset outside the 152-entry pool manifest. The pool entries (UCI and ADBench) stay in verification/evidence/dataset_registry/pool_manifest.json, which is archived evidence and is not rewritten; research/dataset_catalog.py presents both through one interface.

roles.principal_pool: UCI or ADBench table of the pool manifest
roles.supplementary: real dataset outside the principal pool, evaluated for a stated reason
roles.synthetic: generated by the repository, never counted as an independent real-world source
roles.temporal_labelled: real time series with producer-annotated anomalies (natural_temporal study)
roles.duplicate_representation: derived or duplicated copy of a source that is already in the catalog

entries.name: Cardio (historical benchmark CSV)
entries.origin: ADBench 6_cardio.npz, itself derived from UCI Cardiotocography (Campos and Bernardes, 2000, DOI 10.24432/C51S4N)
entries.licence: CC BY 4.0 (UCI source); ADBench packaging BSD-2-Clause
entries.relationship: Verified 2026-11-20: the 21 features and the label of the CSV equal 6_cardio.npz element for element (1,831 rows, 176 anomalies). Same rows, same order; no transformation beyond column naming (f00..f20, label).
entries.labels: anomaly = class 1 of ADBench cardio (pathological recordings); a minority-class proxy, 9.6 %

entries.name: Credit Card Fraud (historical benchmark CSV)
entries.origin: Kaggle mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud v3 (Dal Pozzolo et al.), 150,828,752 bytes
entries.acquisition: manual download from Kaggle (account required); checksum recorded here and in the release evidence
entries.relationship: Verified 2026-11-20: ADBench 13_fraud.npz holds the same 284,807 rows in the same order with identical labels (492 frauds). It drops the Time column and standardises V1..V28 and Amount (correlation 1.0 with the CSV columns, no column byte-identical). Time is the only real time variable of the CSV and is what the chronological studies use.
entries.labels: Class = 1 is a confirmed fraud; genuine rare-event label (0.17 %)

entries.name: Water Quality (potability)
entries.origin: Kaggle dataset of Aditya Kadiwal, read through the mirror github.com/MainakRepositor/Datasets (byte-identical, checked 2026-10-13)
entries.licence: CC0 on the original datacard; the mirror states no separate terms
entries.relationship: Not a UCI dataset and not in the pool. Independent source.
entries.labels: Potability == 0 (not potable) is the positive class, 61 % of 3,276 rows. A common class, not a rare anomaly: an out-of-regime evaluation, never pooled with rare-anomaly results.

schema.type: numeric with real missing values (ph, Sulfate, Trihalomethanes)

entries.name: Synthetic customer records with six anomaly types
entries.relationship: Deterministic: seed 42, 12,000 base rows, rate 3 % per anomaly type (config.RANDOM_SEED, SYNTHETIC_ROWS, SYNTHETIC_ANOMALY_RATE). Not a real-world source and never counted as an independent one.
entries.labels: anomaly and anomaly_type (missing_value, duplicate, univariate_outlier, multivariate_outlier, temporal_drift, invalid_format); ground truth by construction
